---
applyTo: "**/*.{ex,exs,sql}"
---

- Treat the expert-approved crop taxonomy and diagnostic classes in issues #7 and #8 as the V1 source of truth; do not add unreviewed classes as supported.
- Keep crops, pests, diseases, observable symptoms, and management recommendations distinct and explicitly related. Do not equate a symptom with a confirmed diagnosis.
- Store provenance with agronomic knowledge: trusted reference, reviewer/approval status, and review date where available. Do not fabricate missing evidence or attribution.
- Recommendations must be specific to the approved crop and condition, favor expert-reviewed organic management, and be withheld for uncertain or unsupported cases.
- Keep uncertain and unsupported outcomes explicit so the application can request more evidence or refer a case instead of guessing.
